notes.title: Rich Teddy Adventure Screenshot Contest
notes.content:
🎉 Rich Teddy Adventure Screenshot Contest 🎉  

Attention adventurers! We’re excited to announce our Rich Teddy Adventure Screenshot Contest exclusively on Steam! Share your favorite in-game moments and compete for a fantastic prize!  

🖼️ How to Enter: 
1. Take your best screenshot in Rich Teddy Adventure.  
2. Post your screenshot in the Steam Community Hub for Rich Teddy Adventure.  
3. Add a short caption to your post (optional).  

🏆 Prizes:
- 1st Place: A $100 Steam Gift Card!🏆 
- 2nd Place: A $50 Steam Gift Card! 💰  
- 3rd Place: A $25 Steam Gift Card! 💸  
📅 Contest Timeline: 
- Submission Deadline: From December 19, 2024 to December 31, 2024.
- Winner Announcement: The winner will be announced shortly after the submission deadline.

Don’t wait — head into the game, capture your best moments, and upload your entry to Steam!

notes.title: Update 1.3
notes.content:
Update 1.3 Patch Notes  

We’re excited to share the latest updates and improvements in our game:  

- Engine Upgrade: The entire game has been migrated to Unreal Engine 5 for improved performance and visuals.  
- New Feature: Added the ability to purchase coins in-game.  
- Lighting Enhancements: Improved lighting across maps for a more immersive experience.  
- Control Improvements: Adjusted control settings for smoother and more responsive gameplay.  
- Bug Fixes: Resolved various minor issues
- Optimization: Improved game performance for a smoother experience.  
- Effect Enhancements: Updated several visual effects for a more polished appearance.  

Thank you for your support! As always, feel free to share feedback or report any issues.
